entities.summary: Angela Maria Autsch, baptized as Maria Cäcilia Autsch, religious name Angela Maria of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, was a German religious sister of the Congregation Sisters of the Most Holy Trinity. Her beatification process was opened in 1992.
